scope_note: SECURITY-axis spine for ai-agent-cli: deterministic OSV mining over ['aider', 'gptme', 'openinterpreter'] — which vulnerability classes hit the dependency stacks this category converges on. Advisory in check.py until this lens beats the generic-baseline control.

required.what: Injection vulnerabilities (SQL/command/code/template) have empirically hit this category's dependency stack.
required.aliases: sql injection / command injection / code injection / template injection
required.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; fuzz every input that reaches a query, shell, or template sink.

required.what: Unsafe-deserialization vulnerabilities (pickle/prototype pollution) have empirically hit this category's dependency stack.
required.aliases: unsafe deserialization / pickle / prototype pollution / object injection
required.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; feed crafted payloads to every deserialization entry point and confirm unsafe loaders are absent.

required.what: Denial-of-service / resource-exhaustion vulnerabilities have empirically hit this category's dependency stack.
required.aliases: denial of service / resource exhaustion / memory exhaustion / flood
required.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; replay oversized and flood inputs against the busiest endpoint and confirm size, rate, and timeout limits hold.

required.what: Credential/secret-exposure vulnerabilities have empirically hit this category's dependency stack.
required.aliases: credential exposure / secret leak / sensitive information disclosure
required.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; force a failure path and grep logs and error responses to confirm no tokens or credentials leak.

required.what: Memory-safety vulnerabilities (overflow/UAF/OOB) have empirically hit this category's dependency stack.
required.aliases: buffer overflow / use after free / out-of-bounds read or write
required.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; run the native-code surface under a fuzzer with sanitizers and confirm no crashes on malformed input.

optional.what: Cross-site scripting vulnerabilities have empirically hit this category's dependency stack.

optional.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; render hostile markup through every user-content path and confirm it is escaped.

optional.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; request `../`-style paths through every file-serving route and confirm they are rejected.

optional.what: Regular-expression denial-of-service vulnerabilities have empirically hit this category's dependency stack.

optional.day1_tell: Run a dependency audit (osv-scanner / npm audit / pip-audit) in CI and confirm it fails the build on a known-vulnerable pin; run pathological inputs against user-facing regexes and confirm matching is time-bounded.
